# cannot reach by rule, plus the four it got wrong.
# action=form   this spelling is not a headword; tag it and point at `base`.
#               Mostly the LOWERCASE half of a noun pair (frieden, hering,
#               drittel): the rule only ever looks at the capitalised side,
#               so a spurious lowercase entry was invisible to it.
# action=keep   both spellings are real and must NEVER be tagged. `mal`
#               (zipf 6.28) was tagged `abbrev` and demoted in search — it is
#               one of the commonest particles in German.

column1: # ── non-standard spellings, found 2026-07-26 by the rewritten example check ──
# Each of these has a card whose OWN examples spell the word differently, and
# the examples are right. `sponsoren` is the giveaway: it sits at zipf 3.82
# against `sponsern`'s 2.65, because wordfreq reads it as the plural of a noun
# — borrowed frequency, the disease `forms.py` exists to treat.
# Only the unambiguous ones are here. `Ermittelung`, `Seance`, `aufdringen`,
# `verkündigen` and `niederreißen` were REJECTED for this list: Duden attests
# them (or the defect is in the example, not the lemma), and demoting a real
# word to fix an example would be the more expensive mistake.
